What truly sets it apart is what's not in it - no artificial fragrance, no harsh alcohols, just pure, skin-nurturing ingredients. I've noticed a remarkable difference in my skin's reactivity since incorporating this into my morning and evening routines. The persistent redness around my nose and cheeks has significantly diminished, and my skin feels more resilient against environmental stressors. Even after using active ingredients like retinol, this toner helps maintain my skin's balance. For those of us who've invested considerably in high-end skincare only to be disappointed, this toner proves that sometimes the most effective solutions are the ones that focus on simplicity and purity. It's become an indispensable part of my skincare ritual, providing that perfect foundation for the rest of my routine.

avis.titre: Hydration and Radiance in a Bottle
avis.texte: Disclaimer: This product was gifted in exchange for my honest review. The ANUA Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner has quickly become a standout in my skincare lineup. Designed to brighten and hydrate, this toner is formulated with 70% rice extract, which is known for its ability to nourish and restore a natural glow. The milky consistency is lightweight yet deeply moisturizing, making it easy to layer with other products. It absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no sticky residue—perfect for those who enjoy a minimalistic, non-greasy feel. After just days of use, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and noticeably brighter. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, as I experienced no irritation or redness while using it. The calming properties are a bonus, especially for skin that tends to feel stressed or dull. If you're looking for a toner that enhances hydration, promotes a radiant complexion, and feels luxurious to use, this one is a fantastic choice. I'm so grateful to have had the opportunity to try this product—it's truly a gem!

I have been using the Anua Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner for about a week now, and I can confidently say it's made a difference in my skin! I have combination skin, and finding products that hydrate without feeling heavy or greasy can be tricky. This toner is perfect for that—it's lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized without any stickiness. The milky texture is so soothing, and it provides just the right amount of hydration to balance my skin. I've noticed that my complexion looks more radiant and even, with a subtle glow that's perfect for no-makeup days. It's also gentle enough to use morning and night, and I love how it preps my skin for the rest of my skincare routine. I've been applying it with my fingers, gently patting it in, and it feels very calming—no irritation at all. It works beautifully on my dry areas while keeping my T-zone from getting too oily, which is a huge win for my combo skin. Overall, this toner has become a staple in my routine. If you're looking for a hydrating, glow-boosting product that works for combination skin, I'd highly recommend giving this a try. This review is collected as part of promotion.

This gentle rice milk toner has become my new favorite in my skincare routine lately. My skin feels more hydrated after using it. The toner is milky, feels watery and lightweight on my skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue and my skin feels plump, refreshed and dewy. I've also noticed a subtle but noticeable glow since using this toner. My skin looks more radiant, hydrated and healthy. I also like that this toner feels incredibly gentle on my skin. I have sensitive skin and there are days where my moisture barrier is compromised, and this toner hasn't caused any irritation at all. I really like this toner and would definitely repurchase this toner again!

avis.titre: Definitely a new favorite that actually does what it claims!
avis.texte: Anua Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner is a lightweight milky toner enriched with Niacinamide and Ceramides, to hydrate and brighten the skin, promoting a radiant look leaving it glowing with a refreshing glass skin finish. For those with concerns of Aging, Dryness, Dull Skin, Loss of Elasticity, Oil & Shine Control, Sun Protection, Uneven Skin Tone and Wrinkles. This product Helps brightens uneven skin tone, Balancing excess sebum, Smoothens rough skin texture, and It's perfect for strengthening the skin barrier. Enjoy the quick-absorbing, milky texture that leaves your skin feeling refreshed and never sticky, perfect for daily use and as a base for any Korean Skin Care rituals. I was skeptical at first because of the ingredients of ceramides because I hace sensitive skin but wow this is pretty gentle! I must say , this toner is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves the skin feeling soft and plump without a sticky residue like some toners i've used before! I've noticed a subtle glow and my skin looks less dry/dull. I've noticed a little bit of breaking out with this product but I might just be purging of my skin. Overall, I do like this product fit it's natural glow and plan to use this as a staple in my routine!

The Anua Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner stands out as a highly effective hydrating product. Its formulation, enriched with 70% Rice Bran Water and Ceramides, deeply nourishes and restores the skin barrier, making it perfect for those with dry or combination skin. After incorporating it into my routine, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's moisture levels—my face felt soft and plump after just a few uses. This hydration factor is what truly impressed me and convinced me to keep using it. However, one downside I experienced is the slight sticky feeling it leaves on the skin. While it absorbs well after a few minutes, the initial tackiness might not appeal to everyone. On the positive side, this toner prepares the skin beautifully for the next steps in a skincare routine, creating a smooth base for serums or creams. Its lightweight milky texture feels luxurious, and the glow it imparts is undeniable. Overall, despite the stickiness, it's a great toner for achieving hydrated, radiant skin. This's review was collected as part of a promotion

As a beauty and skin care enthusiast, I'm always excited to try new products to add to my routine. The ANUA Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner has been a great. The instructions are vague, it says "apply an appropriate amount to the skin." I just applied enough to put all over my face and neck. First time I used it, I simply poured some in my hand and just patted around my face. I now just use cotton pads and apply it to my skin. The product is liquidy and when trying apply to the cotton pads I sometimes add too much. I appreciate that it doesn't have a strong fragrance. This doesn't feel a sticky feeling on the skin and really hydrates the skin. I've been using this toner both morning and night. I have combination skin, during winter my skin gets really dry. I did notice a difference after using the product, my skin feels and looks hydrated. This toner has left my skin looking glowy and smooth. I also like that this toner contains niacinamide which is a good ingredient that helps with controlling oily skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion*

I am someone that has very dry/dehydrated skin so I always enjoy a really hydrating toner and I find that milky toners work best on my skin type. This is a more thinner consistency but I still felt it did the job at giving my skin a blanket of hydration. It played very well with my other skincare products, it gave my skin an instant glow and boost of hydration so that's all I could really ask for when it comes to a hydrating toner. I can see this being great for all skin types so if you're oily/combo definitely consider this toner if you're looking for a new toner to add into your routine. I would absolutely purchase this repeatedly. I didn't experience any irritation or discomfort and this is coming from someone that has pretty sensitive/reactive skin.

avis.titre: I would definitely use this product again
avis.texte: I first want to say that I give this product 5 stars as I feel that it went above and beyond for me. I am a brown skin woman with combination skin and this product worked very well for me in my skin care routine. I like that it has the off-white milky color as you know that it has the active ingredients from the rice working. I like that it feels really soothing on the skin and not strong or stripping. I feel that it preps my skin nicely after I have thoroughly cleansed my face. I will be using this until the last drop. I recommend this to anyone else who likes a nice mild toner and not soothing.

My name is Eleanor and I am an avid skincare lover in my 20s. The Anua 70 Glow Milky Toner is a soothing and hydrating toner that helps cleanse and hydrate my skin after I wash my face. I really enjoyed using this toner as part of my skincare routine. I used it after cleansing every night, and it gave my skin a soft glow and left it feeling soothed and hydrated. The toner has a nice milky texture and feel to it and it felt amazing on my skin. It didnt leave it feeling dry or sticky at all which was a savior since my skin can get super dry in the winter. After swiping this on my face with a cotton round, it left my skin feeling soft, hydrated and glowy. I thought this product did an amazing job and I love that it has soothing ingredients like rice bran water. Overall this is a wonderful milky toner, and I think I will incorporate this into my skin care routine. I would recommend this to anyone who wants a nice soothing toner that isnt too harsh, especially if you have dry skin. This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using this product for a little over a week now and its continuing to grow on me and work for my skin. I have super sensitive skin and as an esthetician I'm extremely cautious and picky about what I put on my skin. I've noticed a difference in the overall appearance of my skin, there is a noticeable glow and brightness and my skin feels so much more hydrated. I appreciate that the texture is lightweight and absorbs into my skin nicely and there is no fragrance which is good for my sensitive skin. I did notice the first day or two my skin felt a little irritated after application and even oily throughout the day which discouraged me and made me a little hesitant about committing to this product but after my skin had gotten used to it there hasn't been any issues. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for extra hydration but would advise to only use once a day if you're acne prone or sensitive. *This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

The Anua Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner was a product I was incredibly excited about trying since I've been searching for a good toner that doesn't lead to massive breakouts for my sensitive skin. Especially since my moisturizer has been less effective due to drier air and winds in my area. I spot-tested my cheek area and found the formula to be lightweight, smooth, and slightly oily. Initially, the toner was fine, but in conjunction with my acne medication and benzoyl peroxide face wash, adding the toner over-sensitized my skin and led to pretty severe peeling where I spot-tested it. However, I noticed it did give the spot-tested part of my face a noticeable glowier sheen, and it wasn't overly oily even after leaving it on overnight. Despite this, I wouldn't purchase this product again since it burned whenever I used it in my typical routine. If I weren't using topical medication currently, the toner would've been a perfect addition to my skincare routine as it is free of typical pore-clogging ingredients - which is rare! The packaging is nice, but I would prefer if there were a way to apply it without using toner pads or pouring it into my hands; a spray bottle would've done well. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.

Been using this toner for about a week now. The smell is nice it's a semi sweet creamy smell. (Almost reminded me of milk and sugar smell). The feel of it is also very creamy. Like a part milk part water ratio. I used this every day after I get out the shower then use my moisturizer, and the results is a glowy dew like complexion. I think this stuff would be amazing in the summer time! Think about being out in the sun having a little redness this just seems like it would feel very soothing! Overall I give this product 5 stars!

She would use it as a natural toner, and now, seeing this Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner, I can't help but feel nostalgic. With 70% rice extract, I've noticed that my complexion looks brighter and more even over time. It also layers well with other skincare products, making it a great step in both my morning and nighttime routine. I can see why rice water has been loved for generations. avis.titre: East to add to skincare routine
avis.texte: I've had the opportunity to try the ANUA Rice 70 Glow Milky Toner for a couple weeks now and it's become a must do step in my skincare routine. I have combination skin that leans towards dry, especially in the wintertime, so using a hydrating toner is making a difference in my skin health. It's lightweight and easily absorbed. The ceramide is a great ingredient that I see helps my skin barrier stay naturally healthy. It adds an immediate glow as well. It also plays well with my other products I use.

After trying this toner for a week, my pores are the first thing I noticed a change with. The pores on my cheeks are noticeably smaller and tighter. This toner has a slight brightening effect from the rice and niacinamide. I applied it with a cotton round as well as a cotton ball, you can feel a slight tingle but nothing that causes irritation. After washing my face, this toner gets any left behind residue that may still be in the pores. I feel it sucks everything that is below the surface out better than other toners. You can visibly see it on the cotton round. My face looks more glowy and shiny, giving the glass look. I have heard so much about Anua's brand so I was eager to try Milky Rice Toner. This toner worked well with my combination skin, it is milky so it hydrates but effective.
